text:
Maria Chen: Morning — planning to land the 'launchpad' change in tomorrow's release train at 09:30 PT originally, but possible shift. It's a lightweight rollout (web + api). No schema changes. Need: smoke owner, rollback owner, and a quick preflight. I'll do the feature-flag canary first. CC @Priya @Samir
Samir Patel: I can take smoke for web during the slot. If we keep 09:30 I'm fine. What's the minimal smoke checklist? :thumbsup: 
Maria Chen: Minimal checklist: 1) health endpoints pass 2) key flows (signup/login/search) smoke 3) latency check under 95th percentile threshold 4) logs for errors < 1%
Maria Chen: Quick smoke commands to run (staging):
```
curl -sSf https://staging.launchpad.redwood/health | jq .
./infra/run_smoke.sh --env=staging --target=web --quick
```
Maria Chen: Rollback plan: flip feature flag off, revert traffic on canary hosts, run `./scripts/rollback_launchpad.sh v2` if needed. Priya, can you own DB fallback checks?
Priya Nair: DB migration is no-op on rows (schema only adds nullable col). I've run it on staging and it's fine. I can be rollback owner and be online 09:15-10:30 PT.
Jon Reyes: Left a quick CR comment on the canary toggle PR — header mismatch in the new route. Small fix, but would prefer to merge after it's addressed.
Maria Chen: Thanks Jon — I'll address the CR this evening and aim to merge after CI is green by 08:30 PT. Will ping here when merged.
Lina Gomez: Heads up I have a customer demo at 09:30 PT, can we nudge to 10:00 PT? If not I can swap off the demo but prefer later.
Samir Patel: 10:00 PT works for me too.
Maria Chen: OK shifting to 10:00 PT then. Updated tentative timeline: merge by 08:30 PT, preflight 09:45 PT, canary toggle 10:00 PT, smoke 10:05 PT, full rollout 10:20 PT if green. Any objections?
DeployBot: Scheduling note: release-train slot reserved for "launchpad" on 2026-03-18T17:00:00Z (10:00 PT). CI preflight window: 08:00-09:30 PT. Reminder to update release doc with roll and fallback steps.
Priya Nair: I'll run preflight at 09:45 PT and check DB probe + schema validation. Samir you take smoke at 10:05?
Samir Patel: Yep I'll be at my desk. Smoke pickup at 10:05 and I'll post a short report: pass/fail + any exceptions.
Maria Chen: Great — rollback owner: @Priya. Smoke owner: @Samir. Canary owner: me. If anything looks off, we stop and roll back.
Jon Reyes: Noted. I'll re-check the merged PR after Maria updates.
Lina Gomez: Thx — I'll update my calendar. Good luck! :rocket:
Maria Chen: Thanks all — I'll post final confirmation after merge. If anyone wants to pair on the smoke run, ping me in #eng-oncall.
